x: Mel Batty won in 48:13.4 which was 3rd fastest time ever, behind Heatley and Zatopek. It's good to see Colin Clair back in the Belgrave fold again.

CENTRE: Charlie Walker seeks refreshment in the Polytechnic water jump after a brilliant first marathon in 2:33:07. BOTTOM LEFT: Gerry North (2) seems to have hit the tape first in the AAA v London University 2 miles---but award went to Mel Batty.
Mel Batty was the winner in a record 29:58. This race also saw the welcome return to racing of Bob Glover who finished 31st in an untroubled 33:38.
The race was won by Mel Batty in the amazing record time of 1:41:42. Moore,Newell and Shingles brought Cadogan AC home 2nd in the Middlesex County Championship held in conjunction.
Fastest of day: M.Batty(Thurrock)13:01, S.Purkis(Romford)13:18, R.Young(Hornchurch)13:27, J.Hogan(Poly)13:28, L.O'Hara(Bels)13:36 .

Geoff North led the team home with a very good 6th place, only 40 secs behind the winner, Mel Batty. Gerry North, perhaps feeling some after effects of Mexico City,was a little off colour but still finished 13th.
Fastest times:- M.Batty (Thurrock) 16:49 (rec), Gerry North (BELS) 16:58, T.Bivens (Ealing) 17:15, L.O'Hara (BELS) 17:24.

The race was dominated by Mel Batty who is now showing his old form of 2 years ago. He made it look easy and romped 7 seconds ahead of Bob Holt with John Baldwin (Blackheath) a further second away, third.
